subject: The FDA won’t tell Americans where their generic drugs are made
posts: Transparency is the only cure for a system hiding in plain sight. The FDA won’t tell Americans where their generic drugs are made. Evidence: Public safety, investigative transparency, systemic accountability. #Health #Transparency
